name: NCBS-ICTS CALIBRE AI in Biology Postdoctoral Fellowship
funder: National Centre for Biological Sciences (NCBS-TIFR) and ICTS, Bengaluru
amount: Rs 1,25,000/month consolidated + Rs 3 lakh/year research and travel grant
other_rules: PhD in natural sciences or computer science with an outstanding record
project must apply AI to biology
must contact and propose a mentor at NCBS and/or ICTS before applying
notes: 2026 deadline was 1 Mar 2026. Fellows take part in teaching, workshops and outreach. NCBS also runs other linked postdoc programmes (e.g. with Imperial College and CRG Barcelona).

documents.name: Lay summary
documents.notes: Why and how the AI approach transforms the target area

documents.name: Research proposal
documents.notes: Background, aims, approach, future plans, relevance

documents.name: Reference letters
documents.notes: At least 2, emailed by referees to acadoffice@ncbs.res.in
